The BD dependency therefore has TWO halves taking DIFFERENT remedies (Rule 24 iv): (i) HISTORY 2020-01..2024-01 -- a one-time frozen import (closed-period-immutable, Rule 25 kind) or an accepted floor, never a standing feed -- SOVEREIGN FORK carded to Andrew; (ii) the three IDENTITY/ROLE join dims (blackdiamond/49f/silver/dim_advisor_fee_role, dim_account_xref, fact_bd_allocation) -- light tables the runner framework already reads as JOIN DIMS (JD1/JD2 pattern), to be hosted by 49F direct per his 08-21 strategic frame ('these custom dim tables ... are going to need to be hosted by them direct'). The D3 exact-join spec (SmartX<->BD/Schwab) folds into this PRD as a section -- the account_id join measured here IS the Schwab-plane half of it.
